description: Refactor step M12a, class A (docs/plans/codebase-refactor.md §6.5): internal/persistence/postgres's org_repository.go splits by concern. The plan, the provider's subscription snapshot, grandfathering and the budget and hosted-minutes alert claims go to org_repository_billing.go, with keepNightlySQL, which SetPlan and ApplyBillingState share; the release channel, stable release, upgrade window, the channel lists with effectiveChannelSQL, and a member's early switch to the next stable release to org_repository_release.go; memberships to org_repository_membership.go; people-teams (orgs.TeamRepository) to org_repository_team.go; soft delete, restore, the deleted-workspace lists and PurgeOrg to org_repository_purge.go. org_repository.go keeps the type, its constructor, the column lists, scanOrg and the workspace row's own reads and writes. declmove does not move a free-floating comment, so the two section markers (billing, people-teams) are deleted from org_repository.go and each new file gets a header naming its concern. Preview with: go run ./internal/tools/declmove -n -spec internal/tools/declmove/specs/M12a.json
